**The design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was on line 18 of `rtl/mod10_counter.v`. The load condition was checking `d > 4'd10` when it should check `d > 4'd9`. According to the spec, any value greater than 9 should result in q being set to 0 (since valid BCD digits are only 0-9). The original code incorrectly allowed d = 10 to be loaded as q = 10.

The fix changes the condition from:
```verilog
q <= (d > 4'd10) ? 4'd0 : d;
```
to:
```verilog
q <= (d > 4'd9) ? 4'd0 : d;
```

The simulation now passes with no errors.
